title: Clearance pruning on a Highlands acreage

seo.title: Sample project: Highlands tree pruning | RNC
seo.description: Sample project: clearance pruning over a Highlands roof and driveway near a lake, with a District tree bylaw check before any cut.

summary: Clearance pruning over a driveway and roof on a forested lot near a lake.
scope: Bylaw check for work near the lake
Clearance pruning over the roof and driveway
challenge: Branches hung over the roof and scraped vehicles on the driveway of a forested lot near a lake.
approach: Before any cutting we checked whether the planned cuts would count as cutting under the District of Highlands tree bylaw, because the lot is close to a lake.
We pruned for clearance over the roof and driveway, removed deadwood and left the canopy intact. The work was booked for winter, outside the main nesting season.
result: Clear roof and driveway, with the bylaw question answered before work.
